text:
Bards of the College of Reflections consider themselves as
the centrepiece for all their tales and performances. They will
accept nothing less than a reputation akin to godhood where
people will revere them wherever they go. Bards of other
colleges consider this college to be filled with narcissistic and
vain people, though they still can’t deny the level of
showmanship and competency they have when it comes to
entertaining others.

You are exceedingly good at making other people pay
attention to you. When you cast a spell that requires at least
one target to make a saving throw to avoid being charmed by
you, you can expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration and
have the targets of the spell roll with disadvantage. You can
also use this feature on spells which state a creature is
unaffected by the spell's effects because it is immune to being
charmed (such as the suggestion spell).

You are always conscious of your appearance and won’t let
others stage you up. You learn the enthrall spell, which
doesn’t count against the number of bard spells you know.
You can cast this spell without expending a spell slot a
number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum
of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a
long rest.

You performances are always acknowledged and rewarded.
When you make an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw
and the roll succeeds, you can use your reaction to expend
one use of your Bardic Inspiration to gain one of the
following benefits based on the roll.
Ability Check. When you succeed on the ability check, you

can choose to use the new total for one ability check you
make before the end of your next long rest.
Attack Roll. When you succeed on the attack roll, you can roll

a Bardic Inspiration die and deal bonus damage equal to
twice the number rolled.
Saving Throw. When you succeed on the saving throw, you

can give yourself advantage on the next saving throw you
make.

You make sure to always boast your own abilities. Whenever
you fail an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw, you can
use your reaction to expend one use of your Bardic
Inspiration and roll a Bardic Inspiration die, adding the
number to the roll and potentially turning it into a success.
When you use your Bardic Inspiration in this way, you regain
that use of Bardic Inspiration when you finish a long rest.
